text:
Elena: Quick sync thread for final landing copy + routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Goal: publish next Thurs. Pushed new frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zz99/launch-landing (pages: 'Hero variants', 'CTAs & routing').
Tom: Thanks. Proposal: shared subhead, 3 hero lines. Drafts: Hosted = 'Instant API access to production-ready LLMs' ; Dedicated = 'Committed GPU pools for predictable throughput' ; Private = 'Run inference within your VPC — full controls'.
Ravi: Thumbs up. Hosted hero should have a small benchmark CTA: 'See benchmarks' that links to blog + gated slides to capture webinar interest.
Jo: For microcopy, avoid hard pricing on hero. Legal prefers 'cost-optimized tiers'. We can show ranges on the pricing modal.
Priya: Inbound routing: Hosted -> self-serve signup; Dedicated -> capacity scoping call; Private -> security questionnaire + demo request. Each CTA needs unique UTM and a CRM tag.
Elena: Suggested UTM pattern: ?utm_source=website&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=cta_<mode>. Agree on tags?
Priya: Use tags: hosted_selfserve, dedicated_capacity, private_security. Also add benchmark_interest when they click slides. Dedicated CTA should auto-create a CRM task assigned to SolutionsEng.
Tom: Copy tweak: under Dedicated CTA add one-liner microcopy: 'Reserved capacity, SLA-backed performance.' Keep it short.
Ravi: For the benchmark card copy: 'Benchmarks across hardware: latency (P50/P95), throughput, and cost. View methodology and results.' Link to gated slides and blog. We'll use that to feed webinar invites.
Jo: For Private page add badges row (SOC2, ISO27001, VPC, HSM) with hover microcopy pointing to cert pages. Engineering will provide links.
Elena: Webinar logistics: @launch-bot can you create invite for May 12 10am PT titled "Serving LLMs at Scale" and add hosts Ravi + Jo? Also create an audience segment 'benchmark_engagers'.
launch-bot: calendar.create_invite: "Serving LLMs at Scale"  May 12 10:00 PT. Hosts: Ravi, Jo. Link: https://meet.example/webinar. audience.create_segment: 'benchmark_engagers'.
Tom: Dev handoff checklist: CTAs wired to correct endpoints, UTMs applied, CRM tags mapped, Dedicated CTA creates task, Private badges link to certs, benchmark CTA gated slides + capture email.
Priya: Also ensure the Hosted page exposes secondary 'Talk to sales' for high-volume customers (this should create tag hosted_sales_lead).
Ravi: Benchmark blurb will include a one-line highlight: 'Up to 3x cost savings on high-concurrency workloads' with a link to methodology. Keep claims conservative and linked to full data.
Jo: I'll prepare the tooltip copy for badges and drop cert links in the Figma frame.
Elena: Copy freeze Tue EOD, dev handoff Wed 9am. Can everyone review the final Figma by Tue noon?
Tom: Confirmed.
Ravi: Confirmed.
Jo: Confirmed.
Priya: Confirmed.
Elena: Thanks team 6806b44. I'll post the final checklist (UTMs, tags, task creation rules, cert links) after the review.
